topic: Repeat customer rate ko simple 10-customer example se samajhna
caption:
10 naye customers mein se 6 ne 30 din ke andar dobara order diya. Repeat rate = 6 ÷ 10 × 100 = 60%. 👇

Ek hi period aur same first-time customer group track karo, warna number misleading ho sakta hai. Repeat orders batate hain ki kitne log wapas aaye—par kyun aaye ya nahi aaye, ye feedback se samjho.

Aap apne returning customers ko kaise track karte ho?

#BusinessJalwa #CustomerRetention #SmallBusiness #BusinessMetrics #Hinglish

scenes.narration: Maan lo das naye tiffin customers aaye. Unmein se chhe ne tees din ke andar phir se order kiya. Repeat rate kitna hua?
scenes.question: 10 naye customers

scenes.narration: Repeat rate ka formula hai: wapas order karne wale customers, divide pehli baar aaye total customers, multiply sau.
scenes.question: Formula kya hai?

scenes.narration: Chhe divide das multiply sau barabar saath percent. Is example mein tees din ke andar repeat rate saath percent hai.
Same customer group aur same time period compare karo. Ek hafte ka number aur teen mahine ka number mix karoge to comparison sahi nahi rahega.
scenes.question: Fair comparison?

scenes.narration: Jo wapas nahi aaye unka feedback samjho—timing, taste ya delivery. Phir service improve karke agle thirty days ka repeat rate dekho.
scenes.question: Next kya karein?
